[[File:Richard Handley DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Richard Handley at DecipherCon 1999. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Richard Handley''' wrote for ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''. At [[DecipherCon 1999]] [[Evan Lorentz]] and [[Kim Burns]] briefed him on the Star Trek CCG World Finals.<ref name="fri26">[https://web.archive.org/web/20001024231109/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/photos/FRI/fri26.html DecipherCon 1999 Friday photo fri26], Decipher (Wayback 24 October 2000). Caption: "Evan Lorentz and Super Vol Kim Burns tell Star Wars Insider writer Richard Handley what's happening with the Star Trek CCG World Finals"</ref> The Decipher photo caption calls Burns a "Super Vol" ("Super Volunteer").<ref name="fri26" />

== DecipherCon reports ==
Handley covered the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]] in "[[All Decked Out (Star Wars Insider)|All Decked Out]]" for ''Star Wars Insider'' 48. Its subtitle is "The Competition is Fierce at Decipher's 4th Annual Star Wars CCG World Championships". It opens: "Determined card players congregate at a fancy hotel, competing for high stakes and notoriety." The report covers [[Gary Carman]]'s win over [[Steven Lewis]] in the final, lists the top 12 finalists and covers [[Greg Heisler]]'s win in the first [[Young Jedi]] World Championship. Handley also took the article's photographs.<ref name="swi48">Rich Handley, "All Decked Out", ''Star Wars Insider'' 48 (2000), pp. 78–79; listed in the contents as "Decipher This!". Scan: [https://archive.org/details/star-wars-insider-56b702/page/n81/mode/2up Internet Archive].</ref>

He covered [[DecipherCon 2000]] in "[[Deal With It! (Star Wars Insider)|Deal With It!]]", subtitled "It's a CCG TKO When Star Wars Fans Compete at DecipherCon 2000", in ''Star Wars Insider'' 52.<ref name="swi52">Rich Handley, "Deal With It!", ''Star Wars Insider'' 52, pp. 68–69. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/star-wars-insider-d39bd7/page/n67/mode/2up Internet Archive]. On sale from 27 February 2001: [http://www.starwars.com/community/news/2001/02/news20010221.html Star Wars Insider #52], StarWars.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010418040709/http://www.starwars.com:80/community/news/2001/02/news20010221.html Internet Archive]</ref>
